`formatDate` is defined in `src/utils/helpers.ts:6` and has no file dependencies. `src/utils/helpers.ts` doesn't import anything. The function only uses built-in `Date` methods: `date.toISOString().split("T")[0]`, which returns `YYYY-MM-DD`.

The only other file that exports it is `src/utils/index.ts`, a barrel file that re-exports it from `src/utils/helpers.ts`. According to the code index, `src/utils/index.ts` is also the only file that imports `src/utils/helpers.ts`.
